task_summary.title: Extract first primitive: price-quote-normalizer + R-CGO gate
task_summary.description: First primitive extraction from the duplicated field-mapping logic in Tier1/Tier2/Tier3 fetchers. This task is the highest-leverage refactor and carries the CRITICAL R-CGO hard-blocker gate (AC-8).
task_summary.wip_position: sequential: P1-B1 only (P1-B2 held until P1-B1 DONE)

acceptance_criteria: AC-1: normalizer.go exports NormalizeQuote() with correct signature and output types
AC-2: normalizer_test.go table-driven test with ≥5 rows (VCB, HNX, cache, zero-volume, empty-code)
AC-4: go run ./cmd/sandbox -tier=primitive -module=stock-price -scenario=all exits 0 (all scenarios PASS)
AC-6 (R-CGO-2): grep mattn/go-sqlite3|cgo|import C exits 1 (zero matches in primitive)
AC-7 (R-CGO-3): grep pkg/infrastructure exits 1 (zero matches in primitive, Fence-B)
AC-8 (R-CGO-GATE — BLOCKER): if AC-5+AC-6+AC-7 ALL PASS → R-CGO CLEAR + proceed P1-B2; if ANY FAIL → R-CGO BLOCKED + STOP + escalate to architect

r_cgo_hard_gate.gate_verdict_rule: AC-5 + AC-6 + AC-7 must ALL PASS. If ANY fails, record R-CGO BLOCKED, STOP Phase 1, notify PM/architect for re-cut.
r_cgo_hard_gate.gate_reason: mattn/go-sqlite3 (CGO) must not leak into primitive/module/sandbox boundary. Sandbox must build and run under CGO_ENABLED=0 to prove the fence is genuine and the trust contract (edit JSON, rerun, see result) holds without DB/credentials.
r_cgo_hard_gate.escalation_path: If R-CGO BLOCKED: emit signal docs/signals/dev-stock-price-p1-b1-blocker-<UTC>.json + notify PM in WORK channel

g12_dod_gate.rule: Sandbox must show all scenarios PASSING before task marked DONE
g12_dod_gate.evidence_required: Complete sandbox output summary with all scenario verdicts (golden/edge/failure = PASS/PASS/PASS or equivalent)

wip_enforcement.reason: Sequential primitive extraction (P1-B1→P1-B2→P1-B3) is a learning + validation sequence. Running in parallel would mask fence violations and make R-CGO debugging harder.

extract_targets.shared_pattern: Maps raw exchange payload fields → canonical domain.PriceQuote (price, volume, change, changePct, source, fetchedAt, latencyMs)

fences.fence_a: Primitive must import stdlib + pkg/primitive/* only (STRICT: no mattn/go-sqlite3, no pkg/infrastructure, no application, no interface/http)
fences.fence_b: Module (P1-C) must import primitives + ports only (no mattn/go-sqlite3, no pkg/infrastructure imported directly)
fences.fence_c: Infrastructure (CGO sqlite fetcher) wired only from cmd/server/main.go composition root

constraints: L84 explicit-file staging: git add <path> per file (never -A or .)
Do not modify pkg/infrastructure/fetchers.go (Phase 2 scope G5a)
Do not import infrastructure layer, mattn/go-sqlite3, or application/interface in primitive
Sandbox must be CGO-free: all scenarios pass via JSON fixtures, zero live DB calls
All work on main branch (NO feature branches per CLAUDE.md)
success_gates: R-CGO gate (AC-8): R-CGO CLEAR or R-CGO BLOCKED (blocker escalation)
G12 DoD: Sandbox all-green before task marked DONE
All 9 ACs pass (or blocker gate triggered)
